acceptance.given: Pinned inputs and a recorded result are available for fresh replay evaluation.

oracle.expected: Replay receipts show equal target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, and evidence bindings after reconstructing the original identity and replaying with that same identity.
forbidden: Copied, stale, mismatched, or unattributed evidence is accepted.
Required identity or evidence bindings are omitted while the semantic result is accepted.
oracle.observable: The replay receipt binding fields and identity-comparison checks are inspectable during runtime replay verification.

acceptance.then: The reproduced result is accepted only when every required identity and evidence relationship matches the reconstructed original binding.
acceptance.when: Verification first rebuilds the original binding identity, then launches a fresh replay with that same identity; any changed identity is rejected.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate one required target, validator, dependency, command, Probe, Consumer, snapshot, or evidence binding and verify replay rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconstruct the original binding identity before replay, replay using that identical identity, and reject identity mismatch or incomplete evidence relationships.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt fields and non-authorizing semantics; rollback restores prior binding validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Recorded result -> original identity reconstructed -> same-identity fresh replay -> binding equality verified or stale/evidence-invalid rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pass only if reconstructed and replay identities are equal for all required bindings and receipt evidence is attributable; otherwise terminal failure.

acceptance.given: The repository exposes the supported VDD package route set before evaluation.

oracle.expected: Supported VDD package routes remain present and accessible through the shared Toolchain routing surface.
forbidden: A supported VDD package route is unavailable or removed.
oracle.observable: Route discovery and invocation checks return the supported VDD package routes and successful access responses.

acceptance.then: All supported VDD package routes are still available and callable.
acceptance.when: The supported route set is exposed or changed and route availability is checked.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or misbind a supported VDD package route and verify route availability validation fails.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve and verify availability of every supported VDD package route through the repository Toolchain routing surface.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep existing VDD route names and invocation compatibility; rollback restores the prior route registry behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Route baseline -> route exposure/change -> discovery and invocation -> accessible route set or failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pass only when each supported VDD route is discoverable and callable; any missing or inaccessible route fails.

acceptance.given: An unexecuted case is presented to the success evaluator with no execution receipt for that case.

oracle.expected: The evaluator returns a non-success terminal result such as execution-failed or invalid-input.
forbidden: Success is accepted for an unexecuted case.
oracle.observable: The case evaluation result and its execution-receipt presence check are inspectable in the validator output.

acceptance.then: The unexecuted case is rejected and aggregate success is not granted.
acceptance.when: The evaluator checks execution evidence for the presented case before computing success.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Present a matrix case without an execution receipt and verify the success evaluator rejects it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require an execution receipt for every case before success evaluation and return non-success for an unexecuted case.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve terminal result categories and aggregate semantics; rollback restores prior evaluator implementation.

slice_hint.state_transition: Case declared -> execution receipt absent -> pre-success execution gate -> non-success terminal result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success is impossible unless the case has a valid execution receipt; absent execution yields non-success.

acceptance.given: A target path supplied for operation escapes its permitted repository scope or boundary.

oracle.expected: The operation is rejected or blocked before any target-dependent work proceeds.
forbidden: An escaping target is accepted or used.
The target crosses its permitted boundary.
oracle.observable: The target containment check returns a rejection and no downstream target operation is recorded.

acceptance.then: The escaping-target condition is rejected and no target-dependent operation proceeds.
acceptance.when: Target containment is evaluated before inspection or validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use a traversal or out-of-root target path and verify containment validation blocks it before inspection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Fail closed on escaping target paths before any inspection, identity binding, or validation operation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve repository-relative target handling and existing rejection categories; rollback restores prior containment check behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Escaping target supplied -> containment check -> rejected/blocked -> no target-dependent operation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No successful terminal result or target read may occur when containment fails; only a rejection terminal state is valid.
